label: organization based or located in
definition: Organization X is based, headquartered or physically located in geographical place Y.
scope_notes: Preserves organization-location scope. Explicit firm/company-in, based-in or headquarters evidence qualifies. Industry, personal residence/birth, nationality alone or non-place corporate affiliation does not.

facts.reason: Ameritech has a Bell-company compound and relative-position path; Bell is a corporate family/name here, not a geographical base.
